scripts.auth: sh -c 'if [ -f .env.local ]; then node --env-file=.env.local server/auth-server.mjs; elif [ -f ../../../.env ]; then node --env-file=../../../.env server/auth-server.mjs; else node server/auth-server.mjs; fi'
scripts.build:hosted: bun run inventory && EXPO_PUBLIC_PROJECT_SPACE_PROTOTYPE=0 bunx expo export --clear --platform web --output-dir dist && cp public/project-inventory.json dist/project-inventory.json
scripts.build:prototype: EXPO_PUBLIC_PROJECT_SPACE_PROTOTYPE=1 bunx expo export --clear --platform web --output-dir dist-prototype
scripts.native:dev: bun run inventory && bunx expo start --host lan
scripts.native:ios: bun run inventory && bunx expo start --ios
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n auth,web "bun run auth" "bun run web -- --port 8082"
scripts.web: sh -c 'if [ -f .env.local ]; then node --env-file=.env.local ./node_modules/expo/bin/cli start --web "$@"; elif [ -f ../../../.env ]; then node --env-file=../../../.env ./node_modules/expo/bin/cli start --web "$@"; else expo start --web "$@"; fi' --
